reviews.author: Peter Foster
reviews.text: Just had 4 New Tires installed on Lisa & my Honda CR-V Service was Fast, Efficient and Affordable i just called The Shop aand Spoke to John Jr. Said i was lookingTires for an upcoming trip.You Know the Kind a Jolly Fellow dressed in Red might do. Before I could Say Get 4 of them Jr said they will be here tomorrow morning. In All the Years I've Known Johnny and his Family (I mean everyone up there Employees and All Sons,Daughter, in-laws, Grandkids) for about half my life well not quite but close 25 out of the 58 years God has allowed me to stay here among the Living and pass on the knowledge and spirit to anyone Who Needs It!!! I Have Never Seen Better People in all My Life They are Fair, Honest, Truthful and I have even seen them Help Someone who had nothing but what they carried with them and never asked for a dime. God put these Angels Here To Help Those Who Find Themselves with Issues with their Transportation.

reviews.author: Ross Logvin
reviews.text: Great guys!!!! Airbag on my trailer blew up on Sunday and no one was able to help me except this guys! They did amazing job, quickly and without any issues. My truck was able to deliver the load on time. Their rate was amazing as well. Highly recommend this guys for your repairs. Thank you very much!!!!

reviews.author: Georgiy Simonyants
reviews.text: Great roadside service! They arrived quickly and replaced both steer tires on my semi truck without any issues. Ken did an excellent job, professional, fast, and efficient. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dagneris Leyva
reviews.text: I’ve been in business with my trucking company for over 8 years, and this is the first time I’ve come across such an honest, responsive, and reasonably priced service and towing shop. One of my trucks broke down in their area, and I chose them based on their Google reviews, and I’m glad I did. Johnny answered the phone, and he was very helpful and courteous from the start. They dispatched roadside service right away, but unfortunately, the issue couldn’t be fixed on-site. We decided to tow the truck to their yard for further diagnostics. After inspecting the truck, Johnny explained that the issue was related to an electronic component in the automatic transmission, which they don’t repair in house. Instead of trying to take on something outside their scope, he referred me to a reputable local shop that specializes in that type of repair. They tow the truck to that shop, where it is currently being repaired. The total bill was only $650 for roadside service, towing, and diagnostics, which I found extremely reasonable, and honestly, underpriced for the level of service provided. I truly appreciate their honesty, professionalism, and willingness to help. I highly recommend them 100%.

reviews.author: Jenny H
reviews.text: We had a blowout heading down to Florida with our travel trailer and we had no idea where to go to get a new spare, luckily, these guys were right off the highway and helped us out. Great people, super friendly and helpful! Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Sai Rohan
reviews.text: I had a tire issue on my semi truck and stopped by these guys did an excellent job! The team was quick, professional, and knew exactly what they were doing. They diagnosed the problem right away and had me back on the road in no time. As a truck driver, time is money, and their fast service really made a difference for me. They handled everything with care and precision. It’s not easy finding reliable tire service for a big rig, but I’ll definitely be coming back here whenever I’m in the area. Highly recommended for any trucker or driver needing quality tire repair or service. Thanks again for the great work!

reviews.author: Tommy K
reviews.text: Came in on a Sunday morning. They got right on my problem and fixed it in an hour. Very knowledgeable mechanic.

reviews.author: Ronald Richardson
reviews.text: Needed tires. Called they let me know how much. Got here in and out in 30-45 minutes at the price we agreed on. Good business. Will be back if I’m in the area. Thanks.

reviews.author: Howard Greer II
reviews.text: Very professional and quick service. 100% would recommend. Our truck had a minor issue while in Dunn and they got us fixed quickly same did not charge us out of town prices. Very fair on price and they arrived in less than 30 minutes to help us.

reviews.author: Emantrd
reviews.text: I want to thank you for turning my nightmare into a reasonably solved issue. I had my truck break down in Dunn and I reached to you them to tow. They showed up promptly and offered to hold my trailer at their yard at no additional charge I am so appreciative of there kind service when I was down. I want everyone to know if you are in need of a tow. I would err you to reach out to them. From my to you .....THANK YOU

reviews.author: Justin Hall
reviews.text: Our SUV wouldn’t start on a Sunday afternoon after we used rest stop. After two calls of shops that wouldn’t get us we found Interstate and Johnny had our truck towed immediately after we called him. We had very little money being that it was the end of the month. We explained this to Johnny and this wonderful man said no problem. He got our truck fixed that day as well as fronted us the money for a hotel room that he recommended for two days until we got paid. The room was a half hour away because he put us where we could walk to stores and restaurants without having to Uber or cab it. He had us driven there and picked up two days later. He lent us cash as well. We thought a switch in the truck went bad and Johnny’s mechanic realized the battery was super dead. We were going to change the battery anyway so he could have charged us for both. I definitely recommend Johnny and Interstate Auto and Truck Services. We need more people like this in the world.We are touring the country and this could have been a real nightmare for us.

reviews.author: Stephen Nieroda
reviews.text: These guys are great!! Highly recommend this shop. Broke down not far away. They towed me in dropped everything to get me rolling and had me home for Father's Day. Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Nick- GOLD S TRANSPORTATION
reviews.text: Super friendly team, reasonable prices,the best service in the area,they also work hard at night too.

reviews.author: Deici Vargas
reviews.text: Family-owned business. Just wanted thank John and his staff for services performed on my Volvo truck last week. Broke down in Wade, NC. Truck stop recommended them. The owner came out and assessed the truck and ordered part which came the next morning. He removed and replaced the u-joint, strap kit and yoke. And we were back rolling in the afternoon. Very kind, and honest people who cared about getting us back on the road. These guys know what they are doing. Thank You very much.

reviews.author: Rudy Bouso
reviews.text: John and his crew were very professional and courteous. The tire was replaced quickly and we were back on the road. We appreciate their service and highly recommend them to anyone in need.

reviews.author: Kimberly Townsend
reviews.text: Johnny and Barney were an absolute life saver! I was driving from South Carolina to Pennsylvania and my car started to overheat. Thankfully I was able to make it to a gas station. I started looking online and very auto repair places were closed since it was a Sunday. I came across Johnny’s shop Interstate Auto & Truck Services and gave him a call. He helped put me in contact with Barney with Barney’s Auto Truck & RV Repair Service. Within just a few hours Barney had my car fixed, came to pick me up to take me back to my car after they had already dropped me off at a near by hotel. There are honestly no words to describe how helpful, generous and kind these men were. I can’t recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Nicole Bergeron
reviews.text: We were traveling from NH to FL and got a blowout. Finding our at 445am we had no spare they got us to a tire shop safe and sound just about within an hour they are the best Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Paul Antonio
reviews.text: John is an excellent workman with a sincere desire to help. My wife and I were returning to Connecticut from our honeymoon in Myrtle Beach when we broke down with smoke on I-95 on a Saturday. The fire chief arrived and recommended John's services to pick us up. One of his drivers took us to the Interstate lot where met John, who drove us to the Hardee's down the street where we could use a clean restroom and continue to make calls. I explained our situation to him, and he made calls to shops and professional contacts. He made some good recommendations for local auto service and even held our vehicle in the lot over the weekend since everyone else was closed. Our car was delivered to the shop early Monday morning. John is a truly caring person and, from what I could see, an excellent manager of his team. He's family oriented, true to his faith, and very good at what he does. Thank you, Interstate, for helping make our potential honeymoon disaster into a bit more of a pleasant memory.

reviews.author: Becky Katula
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! Willing to go the extra MILE to make any customer happy. I would 100% recommend the shop and any service they have to offer. I am from NJ, broke down on HWY 40 in NC and they towed me all the way to Myrtle Beach, SC! Mike was kind and funny and w/o him my vacation would have never happened! Thank you Interstate Auto & Truck Service!

reviews.author: B.O.Y. Transport LLC
reviews.text: This place is great. They have worked on my tractor trailer twice. Each time was a great experience. These guys know what they are doing. Price is fair. I definitely recommend Interstate Auto & Truck service to any owner operator that needs their truck repaired.

reviews.author: JayPea
reviews.text: I can't make enough positive remarks about this company. I own and operate a semi truck in the Carolinas. In the past 3 years I've had Interstate to do work for me. Billy & Johnny have always went beyond expectation. They are very kind & honest people who care about their customers. Downtime has never been an issue. Prices are always fair. And these guys really know their stuff. You will never feel burdened or robbed by Interstate. Hands down, best auto & truck repair shop!

reviews.author: Betty Parker
reviews.text: On a early beautiful Sunday morning in Fayetteville NC we received a very successful tow service from Interstate. The provider techs, Ken and his son were very patient and treated our RV with much TLC and pulled it out the bogged it was in with ease. Thanks Ken & son, you guys were great! Have a great Sunday!! P.S. To any consumer looking for RV towing you definitely will not go wrong choosing the services provided by Interstate!! Peace & Blessings to you both!!! Mr. & Mrs. Parker!!!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.text: Everyone was closed, not a single place we called wanted to help. But a woman from the gas station about a mile a way recommended these folks. At 8:30pm on a Sunday night of Memorial Day weekend, willing to help when we needed a tire repair, I can not complain. Thanks for your quick and courteous service.

reviews.author: Danny Parham
reviews.text: We were on a family vacation, headed to Williamsburg, VA with a camper in tow. On Sunday. One of the wheel bearings on the camper disintegrated. After many tries, we were finally connected to these guys. They got the camper so that we were able to drive it back to there shop . They not only were able to fix/replace the bearing, they checked the rest to make sure they were good. They did this on a Sunday evening. For a reasonable cost considering the circumstances. Very happy with the service we received and would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: jamie reffett
reviews.text: This is a family owned business that cares about their customers like I haven't ever experienced before. I had just paid another shop 9K and had used them for 3 years and they never treated me like the folks at Interstate did! I broke down in the fuel island at Pilot exit 75 on I95 in Dunn, NC. Which has a shop....they told me it is after 5 we are closed...did not care that I was blocking a fuel island. Interstate on the other hand sent a gentleman out that got me going only to break down again because it was an electrical issue with ECM wires. Electrical issues are a major pain to track down. They towed me to their shop that night and started on my truck first thing next am. Awesome people!!! I will definitely be back to see them. Thank you Mr. Johnny you and your TEAM rock!!

reviews.author: Collin Smith
reviews.text: Great service! Can get busy but they make it a point to get you taken care of as quickly as possible! Very fair prices as well!

reviews.author: truBus
reviews.text: I had a turbo hose separate on me while going north on 95. I called Interstate Service and Walter was there within a few minutes. He took his time and made sure the job was done correctly. I was back on the road about an hour later. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Nathaniel Hinds
reviews.text: Called and spoke with the owner looking for a shop that could handle exhaust system repairs on my Freightliner truck. The owner was honest and said that he could not do what I needed but was quick to recommend another shop in the area that could. While I was not able to do business with this company, I greatly appreciate the integrity and willingness to help out.

reviews.author: DJs Transport
reviews.text: Johnny was superb! He placed us back on the road immediately by replacing one of our trailer tires. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Ovalle Transport
reviews.text: Called for a tire 295 75 22.5 Sunday around 7pm and he said used $35].00 so I drove to his shop and when I arrived there he said price is now $740.00 for a used tire just for the simple reason that my truck was a car carrier. Did not use the.. that's not good business

reviews.author: Declan Caige (GorillaZod)
reviews.text: My mechanic name was Joe very professional knew what he was talking about. Diagnosed my problem within seconds of getting out of his truck, BEST Mobile Mechanic I’ve ever had hands-down.

reviews.author: Willie Lee
reviews.text: They always make sure I am taken care of in a timely manner. Family oriented also. Good folks. I always recommend them for whatever you may need if they can’t help they will try to point you in the right direction for what you need.

reviews.author: GranDaddyEvil
reviews.text: Hopefully, you'll never break down on the interstate. But if your RVing or driving a big rig (like myself) through this area and need assistance. Interstate is you most honest and fair company in the area.

reviews.author: Fogel G Shimp
reviews.text: Lost a truck tire on i95 South. Emergency management allowed us to back up the ramp. They had one tire left that fit our truck. Got it repaired and was on our way. 400+ miles so far and it's holding up.

reviews.author: Mike Fincutter
reviews.text: Good people called three places to get a alternater fix everybody said next day ,called here said bring it up had me fixed in 1hour and half.anything breaks we will be calling Interstate

reviews.author: Randy TAYLOR
reviews.text: I just called these guys today to fix air bag on our trailer and replace two tires these guys are fast n friendly I can assure you if your a driver these are the guys any trucking company should use many thanks guys God bless from Taylor from Ky driveing for 1 Mtx Llc outta Mo. I'll say when your down to nothing gods up to something he sure was here he lead me to good fast n friendly service im back rolling and will always use this company when ever im in North Carolina or any were near here thanks guys

reviews.text: They damaged my motor home offered me 500.00 to sweep it under the rug. They were contracted under aaa will not return my call . Left noumourus messages for Johnny Jorgensen

reviews.author: Elizabeth Atkinson

reviews.author: Jerome Williams

reviews.author: David Michel

reviews.author: Robert Phillips

reviews.author: Tracy Hall Trippiedi
reviews.text: Can't put enough good words into this review! Courteous, considerate, and knowledgeable. I will highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Deena Youngblood
reviews.text: Wow, amazing service!! We blew a brake chamber on the side of the road and they sent a great mechanic out.

reviews.author: Paul Schriever
reviews.text: Late Saturday afternoon emergency tire replacement on an RV. The employee dropped what he was doing to get my family back on the road.

reviews.author: Al Garcia

reviews.text: Pulled off the highway with a check engine light on my toyota and even though thats not their main clientele here, johnny connected me with another shop in town that could help me out and made sure I was taken care off. The nicest people ever!
